faq.question: What does Zariyah mean?
faq.answer: Zariyah is associated with the Arabic form زَرِيَّة, whose core sense is zariyah; offspring, seed (feminine).

faq.question: What is the origin of Zariyah?
faq.answer: Zariyah is associated with Arabic. Zariyah is a form of Arabic ذَرِيَّة (Dhariyya), meaning 'offspring, seed'.

faq.question: Is Zariyah an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form زَرِيَّة is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Zariyah an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Zariyah can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Zariyah a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Zariyah should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Dhariyya is not a Quranic personal name.
